name: cogno-cortex
summary: The in-process skills framework for the Cogno stack — author skills as BaseTool + manifest, rank them against NER tags, execute via a provider bus, discover from disk, and bridge to cogno-anima's tool contract via CortexDispatcher. The framework, plus a few generic business-free skills behind extras (consult_documents, web_search, web_fetch); infra-agnostic.
author: Vinicius Vale
